description: This file declares APIs related to the Data Model Library support for a specific module in a Cisco system, including functions to get various parameter values such as boolean, integer, unsigned long, and string.
external_methods: /* External methods are not explicitly referenced in function calls but are declared as API signatures */

methods.name: Pam_GetParamBoolValue
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean parameter value given an object context and parameter name.

methods.name: Pam_GetParamIntValue
methods.description: Retrieves an integer parameter value given an object context and parameter name.

methods.name: Pam_GetParamUlongValue
methods.description: Retrieves an unsigned long parameter value given an object context and parameter name.

methods.name: Pam_GetParamStringValue
methods.description: Retrieves a string parameter value given an object context and parameter name.
